page.overview:
What is Cavern Zone?

The Cavern Zone is a location in PokéPark Wii: Pikachu's Adventure. It is a mine primarily inhabited by -type and other cave Pokémon. The player can access the Lava Zone from here. When Pikachu first enters the zone, a Mr.

Mime reveals that the zone's hot spring has dried up and that a piece of the rail for the zone's mine carts has gone missing and requests Pikachu find it.

After questioning Zubat and Aron, Pikachu learns it was Mawile who took the rail piece to prevent more Pokémon from leaving the zone. After Mawile is defeated, she reveals she gave the missing piece to Dugtrio who in turn, hid it in the berry storage area guarded by Marowak.

Pikachu gets Marowak's permission to search the storage area, where he finds a Diglett inside who reveals he relocated the piece underneath the sleeping Snorlax. Pikachu awakens Snorlax with a Thunderbolt and convinces him to move by giving him a Big Berry. When Snorlax moves, a geyser he was sleeping on erupts and restores the hot springs and also shoots out the hidden rail piece. After Pikachu restores the rail, he recovers the mine cart from some Gible and restores access to the Lava Zone. During the search for the three secret words of the Granite Zone, Pikachu returns to the Cavern Zone and receives the final word from Snorlax: Rainbow. Bastiodon's Block Barrage is a game where the Pokémon moves across the bottoms of the screen to kick a ball into one of five panels that give points when they are hit. The ball ricochets against Pokémon and walls, causing it to bounce back and forth from both ends. Bastiodon and Dugtrio act as obstacles in the balls path. Bastiodon moves across the panels and travels according to where the ball is and Dugtrio pop up in between the ends of the field and hit the ball back if it hits them. Each time a panel is hit, its number goes up from one to nine and gives points equal to 100 times it's current number. The Pokémon has a limited number of tries and each time a ball gets past them, they lose one. The attraction ends when the all Pokémon's tries are up.
